summary: Corporate card reimbursement stuck in suspense due to PO allocation mismatch
description: Issue summary: A corporate card transaction (employee reimbursement) is stuck in the finance suspense queue because the AP system rejected the invoice mapping to the Purchase Order. Impact: employee reimbursement delayed; month-end accruals understated for the GL code; finance cannot close the affected vendor ledger line. Environment: Production finance systems: AP platform v4.3, Concur import pipeline, GL mapping service (gl-map-v2). Region: us-east. Steps to reproduce / observed behavior: 1) Employee submitted expense entry for training conference (charge date 2026-03-05). 2) Concur export created a vendor invoice with corporate-card flag and attempted PO allocation to PO-98123 (training PO). 3) AP import reported mapping failure: "PO not found for allocation code 98123-CC" and placed the invoice in suspense queue. 4) The transaction shows duplicated merchant code mapping (MCC 8398 vs MCC 8999) causing the GL code selector to prefer a different cost center. Supporting evidence: AP import logs, Concur export CSV (attached in ticket), suspense queue record ID SUSP-99877. Current status: Ticket created by Finance Ops. Assigned to Payments team for PO/GL reconciliation. Next steps requested below.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 10:14 - Ayesha Khan: Pulled Concur export and AP import log. The Concur row contains PO field '98123-TRN' while AP expects '98123' only. Suspect normalization mismatch in Concur transformation.

2026-03-12 12:07 - Liam Chen: Checked AP import service (ap-ingest-processor). Found entry reject code 422 with message 'Unknown PO key: 98123-TRN'. Line item references GL 6410-training but mapping table expects 6410.0 format. Added to investigation backlog.
2026-03-12 15:30 - Finance Ops (S. Patel): Confirmed employee (EID 7842) submitted receipt; card transaction ID CC-556778; vendor: EventSphere LLC. No duplicate payment exists in payments ledger.

2026-03-12 17:02 - Liam Chen: Reproduced transformation on staging: Concur -> transform script (v1.9) appends suffixes for department tags. Regression introduced in 2026-02-28 deployment. Created PR to revert normalization change (see related PR note in comments).
comments: 2026-03-12 10:25 - Ayesha Khan: Flagging for Payments team - this is delaying employee reimbursement. SLA: please triage within 24 hours.
2026-03-12 12:45 - Liam Chen: I will triage. Initial hypothesis: Concur transform appending department suffix breaks PO lookup. Will test fix on staging and escalate if needed.
2026-03-12 18:05 - Riley Morgan (Finance Manager): If we need a manual release, please provide the suspense record and GL reallocation steps so we can approve immediate reimbursement to the employee.

2026-03-13 09:40 - Liam Chen: Patch created to normalize PO suffixes. Deploying to staging now. If staging import succeeds we will schedule a short prod deploy and run manual reconciliation for SUSP-99877.
2026-03-13 11:02 - Ayesha Khan: Confirmed employee has been notified that this is being handled. They requested estimated payout date.
resolution_notes: Workaround planned: manual override to map suspense record SUSP-99877 to PO 98123 and change GL from 6410.0 to 6410-training in AP console to release payment. Permanent fix: revert Concur transformation change that appends department suffixes to PO field and add validation step in ingest pipeline. PR created to revert (PR: github.com/redwood/fin-transforms/pull/187). Expected prod deploy window: 2026-03-13 18:00-18:15 UTC. Follow-up: run a sweep of suspense queue for entries since 2026-02-28 to identify other affected records.
actions_required: Payments: Manually release SUSP-99877 and process reimbursement to employee EID 7842 (attach manual payment confirmation).
Engineering: Deploy revert to Concur transform (PR 187) and add a schema validation to strip/validate PO field formats.
Finance Ops: Run suspense queue query for records created after 2026-02-28 and confirm whether bulk reallocation needed.
